data.rationale: The proposal gets the right sequence (Allrecipes search, top recipe, Wikipedia origin, note) and the right dish and servings inputs, but it wrongly lists rating, time, ingredients and origin as input parameters when they are values read from the pages. It also leaves out setting the servings on the recipe page, the "New note" click, the note format and the three-ingredient limit, and its steps are too vague to automate without guessing.
